revisions.purpose: Release 0.3.31. Candidates can show a list screened by a Hurricane version that learns from the NIMS SuperCon datasheet. Such a list names its own screening round and date, its remarks name the datasheet instead of 3DSC, say that the candidate is one of the model's background compounds scored by a classifier that left it out, and call a nearest training compound with Tc 0 measured not to superconduct; the pool exclusions count the compounds the datasheet lists. The lead gives the share of superconducting and of measured non-superconducting new parent compounds with a score of at least 0.5 and the three answers for a family not yet found, without a verdict. Version 0.3.31 in the service worker, the app constant and the cache name. The app changes no model result, candidate, score or threshold.
